replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
Avicus doesn't support the use of XML files. If you need help creating the files needed to use maps on other networks, this is not the appropriate place to ask. Please refer to the network specific documentation for the network you need help with, or ask on the forums for that network.

If you need help creating Avicus YAML files, you can check out docs.avicus.net or make another thread in the Map Making subforum.
